original.english_translation: Disyllabic, single-gender words in -στος are accented on the acute, unless the syllable before the last contains one of the naturally short vowels: ἱστός; there is also an island of Libya called νῆσος. Σηστός, a city on the Propontis. It is used in the masculine by Ephorus; but the Athenians say “ἐν τῇ Σηστῷ”. παστός, μαστός, ξυστός. Κραστός, a city of Sicily of the Sicanians. Philistus in the thirteenth book of his Sicilian History. Γραστός, son of Mygdon, from whom comes Γρηστωνία, a region of Thrace. Φαιστός, a city of Crete: “ἐς Φαιστόν, μικρὸς δὲ λίθος” (Od. γ 296). There is also another Φαιστός of the Peloponnese, formerly called Φρίξα. But Φαῖστος, in the case of the hero, is accented on the grave: “Ἰδομενεὺς δ᾽ ἄρα Φαῖστον” (Il. Ε 43). Noted as exceptional is Δύστος, a city of Euboea. Theopompus in the twenty-fourth book of the Philippica: “ἀποστήσας δὲ τοὺς ἐν αὐτῇ τῇ περιοικίδι τῶν Ἐρετριέων ἐστράτευσεν ἐπὶ πόλιν Δύστον”. Also Κάστος and Νάστος, a city of Thrace, which is also called Νέστος; Apollodorus in the second book On the Earth: with barytone accent. But Νέστος, father of Callirrhoe, and a city and a river of Illyria, and also κόστος and νόστος have a short penult. Disyllables in -τος that have σ before the τ, if they are inflected into different genders, tend to be accented on the acute, unless they are superlatives or have been reduced from more syllables to disyllabic form: πιστός, ξυστός, ἀστός, μεστός, κεστός. But πλεῖστος, λῷστος, ῥᾷστος, being superlatives, are barytone. And Πλεῖστος, a river at Delphi, is barytone: “πολλὰ δὲ Κωρύκιαι νύμφαι Πλεῖστοιο θύγατρες”. Apollonius (Argon. II 711). Some, however, read the genitive with circumflex on the antepenult, since it is also pronounced by the locals as Πλειστός with acute; but the local tradition does not prevail. And δύστος, ‘wretched’, and πόστος have come from πόσατος. Verbal adjectives in -τος that are not numerals, having κ or π before the τ, are accented on the acute: πλεκτός, ἑλκτός, πνικτός, θελκτός. But οἶκτος is barytone, for it is not verbal.—Moreover, disyllabic, single-gender words ending in -ος that begin with the diphthong οι tend somehow to be barytone whenever before the -ος syllable there is a consonant or consonants—thus also ἄρκτος and πέκτος, ‘the fleece’, and κάκτος. And Λύκτος, a city of Crete, from Λύκτος son of Lycaon; but some call it Λύττον because it lies in an elevated place. For what is up and high is λύττον.
original.greek_text: Τὰ εἰς 'στος' δισύλλαβα μονογενῆ ὀξύνεται, εἰ μὴ ἡ πρὸ τέλους συλλαβὴ ἔχοι τι τῶν φύσει βραχέων, ἱστός, ἔστι καὶ νῆσος Λιβύης. Σηστός πόλις πρὸς τῇ Προποντίδι. λέγεται δὲ ἀρσενικῶς παρ´ Ἐφόρῳ· οἱ δὲ Ἀθηναῖοι «ἐν τῇ Σηστῷ» φασιν. παστός, μαστός, ξυστός. Κραστός πόλις Σικελίας τῶν Σικανῶν. Φίλιστος Σικελικῶν τρισκαιδεκάτῳ. Γραστός παῖς Μυγδόνος, ἀφ´ οὗ Γρηστωνία χώρα Θρᾴκης. Φαιστός πόλις Κρήτης «ἐς Φαιστόν, μικρὸς δὲ λίθος» (Od. γ 296). ἔστι καὶ ἄλλη Φαιστός Πελοποννήσου ἡ πρότερον Φρίξα καλουμένη. τὸ δὲ Φαῖστος ἐπὶ τοῦ ἥρωος βαρύνεται «Ἰδομενεὺς δ´ ἄρα Φαῖστον» (Il. Ε 43). σεσημείωται τὸ Δύστος πόλις Εὐβοίας. Θεόπομπος ἐν Φιλιππικῶν κδʹ «ἀποστήσας δὲ τοὺς ἐν αὐτῇ τῇ περιοικίδι τῶν Ἐρετριέων ἐστράτευσεν ἐπὶ πόλιν Δύστον». καὶ Κάστος καὶ Νάστος πόλις Θρᾴκης, ἣ καὶ Νέστος λέγεται· Ἀπολλόδωρος δευτέρᾳ περὶ γῆς· βαρύτονα. τὸ δὲ Νέστος πατὴρ Καλλιρρόης καὶ πόλις καὶ ποταμὸς Ἰλλυρίας καὶ κόστος καὶ νόστος βραχεῖ παραλήγουσι. Τὰ εἰς 'τος' δισύλλαβα ἔχοντα πρὸ τοῦ 'τ' 'σ', εἰ παρασχηματίζοιτο εἰς διάφορα γένη, ὀξύνεσθαι θέλει, εἰ μὴ ὑπερθετικὰ εἴη ἢ ἐκ πλειόνων συλλαβῶν εἰς δισυλλαβίαν μεταστῇ, πιστός, ξυστός, ἀστός, μεστός, κεστός. τὸ δὲ πλεῖστος, λῷστος, ῥᾷστος ὑπερθετικὰ ὄντα βαρύνεται. καὶ τὸ Πλεῖστος ποταμὸς ἐν Δελφοῖς βαρύνεται «πολλὰ δὲ Κωρύκιαι νύμφαι Πλείστοιο θύγατρες». Ἀπολλώνιος (Argon. II 711). τινὲς δὲ ἀναγινώσκουσι προπερισπωμένως ἐπὶ τῆς γενικῆς, ἐπειδὴ καὶ ὑπὸ τῶν ἐγχωρίων λέγεται Πλειστός ὀξυτόνως, οὐκ ἐπικρατεῖ δὲ ἡ ἐθνικὴ παράδοσις. καὶ τὸ δύστος ὁ δύστηνος καὶ πόστος ἐκ τοῦ πόσατος γέγονεν. Τὰ εἰς 'τος' ῥηματικὰ μὴ ὄντα ἀριθμητικά, πρὸ τοῦ 'τ' τὸ 'κ' ἢ τὸ 'π' ἔχοντα ὀξύνεται, πλεκτός, ἑλκτός, πνικτός, θελκτός. τὸ δὲ οἶκτος βαρύνεται. οὐ γὰρ ῥηματικόν. —ἄλλως τε φιλεῖ πως τὰ εἰς 'ος' λήγοντα δισύλλαβα μονογενῆ ἀπὸ τῆς 'οι' διφθόγγου ἀρχόμενα βαρύνεσθαι, ὁπότε πρὸ τῆς 'ος' συλλαβῆς σύμφωνον ἢ σύμφωνα ὑπάρχει— καὶ τὸ ἄρκτος καὶ πέκτος ὁ πόκος καὶ τὸ κάκτος. καὶ Λύκτος πόλις Κρήτης ἀπὸ Λύκτου τοῦ Λυκάονος· ἔνιοι δὲ Λύττον αὐτήν φασιν διὰ τὸ κεῖσθαι ἐν μετεώρῳ τόπῳ. τὸ γὰρ ἄνω καὶ ὑψηλὸν λύττον

original.english_translation: And Γόννοι, the city, with two νν; for the Aeolians call the knees γόννα. Σίγυννος: a city of Egypt, as Ctesias says in the first book of his Periploi; and the citizen likewise. Ἄργυννος, son of Peisidice, daughter of Leucon, son of Athamas, son of Sisyphus, son of Aeolus, beloved of Agamemnon, a Boeotian, who, going up to the Cephissus, dies; from him they honored Aphrodite as Ἀργυννίδα. τύραννος: it came about thus. There is Τυρρηνός and Τυρρανός in the Doric dialect, from which, by aphairesis and the addition of a letter, it was called τύραννος. Φάλανος, a city of Perrhaebia, as Ephorus says in book 9. Ἔραννος, a city later called Κυπάρισσος. Βίεννος, a city of Crete: some derive it from Βίεννος, one of the Curetes, others from the violence that occurred concerning Ares, whom they say was bound there by Otus and Ephialtes, the sons of Poseidon. There is also another city in Gaul. Πέλιννος, son of Oichaleus. But those that are feminine are accented with an acute: ἐραννός ‘the desirable’, ἀργεννός, κελαδεννός, ἐρεβεννός. * Words in -νος that have ρ before -νος are accented with a grave: Κάρνος the Phoenician, from whom Κάρνη, a city of Phoenicia, also called Κάρνος in Artemidorus; there is also an island of Acarnania. Artemidorus, book 2 of the Geographoumena: Ἄρνος, who made war on Protogonus, from whom the city Ξάνθος of Lycia was called Ἄρνα; Νάρνος, a river; Κύρνος, the founder, and the island north of Iapygia. Hecataeus in his Europe. Πύρνος, a city of Caria. Σάμορνος: Ephesus was so called. Ἄορνος, a city of the Bactrians, in the masculine and in the feminine. But Λιβυρνός is accented with an acute: an Attic man and a people near the inner part of the Adriatic gulf. Hecataeus in his Europe. Ἀχαρνός, a people near Scythia in Theopompus, also called Ἀχανός. Italian words in -ερνος are paroxytone: Φαλέρνος, πατέρνος; Ἰουέρνος, a people in the British sea; Ἀροέρνος, a people most warlike of the Galatians near Celtic territory. Apollodorus in the fourth book of the Chronica: “the Ἀροέρνοι of the Celts.” Πριουέρνος, a city of Italy. Disyllabic proper names in -ανος, or appellatives without distinction, are accented with a grave: Τάνος, a city of Crete, as Artemidorus says in the fourth book of the Geographoumena; Φᾶνος, the proper name; θρᾶνος, ‘the seat’. original.greek_text: καὶ Γόννοι διὰ δύο 'νν' τὴν πόλιν. γόννα γὰρ οἱ Αἰολεῖς τὰ γόνατα. Σίγυννος· πόλις Αἰγύπτου, ὡς Κτησίας ἐν πρώτῳ περίπλων. καὶ ὁ πολίτης ὁμοφώνως. Ἄργυννος υἱὸς Πεισιδίκης τῆς Λεύκωνος τοῦ Ἀθάμαντος τοῦ Σισύφου τοῦ Αἰόλου ἐρώμενος Ἀγαμέμνονος, Βοιωτός, ὃς ἀνιὼν εἰς τὸν Κηφισσὸν τελευτᾷ. ἀφ´ οὗ Ἀργυννίδα τὴν Ἀφροδίτην ἐτίμησαν. τύραννος· ἐγένετο δὲ οὕτως. ἔστι Τυρρηνός καὶ Τυρρανός κατὰ Δωρίδα διάλεκτον, ἀφ´ οὗ κατὰ ἀφαίρεσιν καὶ γράμματος προσθέσει τύραννος ἐκλήθη. Φάλαννος πόλις Περραιβίας, ὡς Ἔφορος ἐν τῷ θʹ. Ἔραννος πόλις ἡ ὕστερον Κυπάρισσος. Βίεννος πόλις Κρήτης. οἱ μὲν ἀπὸ Βιέννου τοῦ τῶν Κουρήτων ἑνός, οἱ δὲ ἀπὸ τῆς περὶ τὸν Ἄρη γενομένης βίας, ὃν ἐνταῦθα δεδέσθαι φασὶν ὑπὸ Ὤτου καὶ Ἐφιάλτου τῶν παίδων Ποσειδῶνος. ἔστι καὶ ἑτέρα πόλις ἐν Γαλλίᾳ. Πέλιννος ὁ Οἰχαλέως. τὰ μέντοι ἔχοντα θηλυκὰ ὀξύνεται, ἐραννός ὁ ποθεινός, ἀργεννός, κελαδεννός, ἐρεβεννός. * Τὰ εἰς 'νος' ἔχοντα πρὸ τοῦ 'νος' τὸ 'ρ' βαρύνεται, Κάρνος ὁ Φοίνικος, ἀφ´ οὗ Κάρνη πόλις Φοινίκης ἡ καὶ Κάρνος παρ´ Ἀρτεμιδώρῳ. ἔστι καὶ νῆσος Ἀκαρνανίας. Ἀρτεμίδωρος βʹ γεωγραφουμένων, Ἄρνος ὁ καταπολεμήσας Πρωτόγονον, ἀφ´ οὗ ἡ Ξάνθος πόλις Λυκίας Ἄρνα ἐκαλεῖτο, Νάρνος ποταμός, Κύρνος ὁ κτίστης καὶ ἡ νῆσος πρόσβορρος Ἰαπυγίας. Ἑκαταῖος Εὐρώπῃ. Πύρνος πόλις Καρίας. Σάμορνος· ἡ Ἔφεσος οὕτως ἐκαλεῖτο. Ἄορνος πόλις Βακτρίων ἀρσενικῶς καὶ θηλυκῶς. ὀξύνεται δὲ τὸ Λιβυρνός Ἀττικός τις καὶ ἔθνος προσεχὲς τῷ ἐνδοτέρῳ μέρει τοῦ Ἀδριατικοῦ κόλπου. Ἑκαταῖος Εὐρώπῃ. Ἀχαρνός ἔθνος πρὸς τῇ Σκυθίᾳ παρὰ Θεοπόμπῳ τὸ καὶ Ἀχανός. Τὰ εἰς 'ερνος' Ἰταλιωτικὰ παροξύνεται, Φαλέρνος, πατέρνος, Ἰουέρνος ἔθνος ἐν τῷ πόντῳ τῷ Πρετανικῷ, Ἀροέρνος ἔθνος μαχιμώτατον τῶν πρὸς τῇ Κελτικῇ Γαλατῶν. Ἀπολλόδωρος τετάρτῃ χρονικῶν «Κελτῶν Ἀροέρνους». Πριουέρνος πόλις Ἰταλίας. Τὰ εἰς 'ανος' δισύλλαβα κύρια ὄντα ἢ προσηγορικὰ μὴ ἔχοντα διαστολὴν βαρύνεται, Τάνος πόλις Κρήτης, ὡς Ἀρτεμίδωρος ἐν τετάρτῳ γεωγραφουμένων, Φᾶνος τὸ κύριον, θρᾶνος ὁ δίφρος. τὰ μέντοι

Herodian · 1.217

Same ending, different accent

Explore selected words from the passage. Type one Greek word, with or without accents, then compare its accent and explanation. This is a passage lookup, not a general accent predictor.

Reading the terms

Oxytone: acute on the final syllable. Barytone: no accent on the final syllable; this need not mean a written grave accent. πλεῖστος and Φαῖστος have a circumflex on the penult.

The passage distinguishes city Φαιστός from hero Φαῖστος. It also reports a local Πλειστός for the river, but says that local tradition does not prevail. This lookup shows πλεῖστος as the superlative.

"""Executable offline browser assertions. Run with a result bundle argument.
Requires the repository renderer and Playwright with an installed Chromium.
All external requests are intercepted and aborted; no server or database is used.
"""
import builtins
import json
import shutil
import sys
from html import escape
from pathlib import Path
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
real_import = builtins.__import__
def guarded_import(name, *args, **kwargs):
    if name.split('.')[0] in {'db', 'psycopg2', 'stephanos_db'}:
        raise AssertionError('Database import forbidden')
    return real_import(name, *args, **kwargs)
builtins.__import__ = guarded_import
from generate_site import gadget_srcdoc
from cloud_gadgets import digest


def run(bundle):
    records = {'new': [], 'past': []}
    def check(role, case, expected, actual):
        expected, actual = str(expected), str(actual)
        row = {'case': case, 'expected': expected, 'actual': actual, 'passed': expected == actual}
        records[role].append(row)
        if not row['passed']:
            raise AssertionError(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False))
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.launch(executable_path=shutil.which('chromium'), headless=True, args=['--no-sandbox'])
        version = browser.version
        context = browser.new_context(viewport={'width': 1100, 'height': 1000})
        requests = []
        def abort(route):
            requests.append(route.request.resource_type)
            route.abort()
        context.route('**/*', abort)
        def load(candidate):
            page = context.new_page()
            errors = []
            page.on('pageerror', lambda e: errors.append('script error'))
            page.on('console', lambda msg: errors.append('console error') if msg.type == 'error' else None)
            src = gadget_srcdoc(**candidate)
            page.set_content('<!doctype html><html><head><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"></head><body style="margin:0"><iframe title="Educational gadget" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-forms" referrerpolicy="no-referrer" style="border:0;width:100%;height:1600px" srcdoc="'+escape(src, quote=True)+'"></iframe></body></html>')
            frame = page.frames[1]
            frame.locator('main, .wrap, #probe').first.wait_for()
            return page, frame, errors
        def fits(page, frame, width):
            page.set_viewport_size({'width': width, 'height': 1000})
            return frame.evaluate('document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth')

        page, f, errors = load(bundle['new']['candidate'])
        check('new','Initial passage example', 'πιστός', f.locator('#form').inner_text())
        def explore(value):
            f.locator('#word').fill(value)
            f.locator('#word').press('Enter')
        explore('πλειστος')
        check('new','Second input: superlative', 'πλεῖστος', f.locator('#form').inner_text())
        check('new','Superlative exception explained', True, 'superlative' in f.locator('#reason').inner_text() and f.locator('#kind').inner_text() == 'Barytone · superlative')
        explore('Φαιστος')
        check('new','City reading', 'Φαιστός', f.locator('#form').inner_text())
        f.locator('#sense').select_option('hero')
        check('new','Referent switch: hero', 'Φαῖστος', f.locator('#form').inner_text())
        check('new','Hero source citation', True, 'Iliad Ε 43' in f.locator('#reason').inner_text())
        explore('ἱστός'.lower())
        check('new','Accented breathing input', 'ἱστός', f.locator('#form').inner_text())
        explore('Δυστος')
        check('new','Named city exception', 'Δύστος', f.locator('#form').inner_text())
        f.locator('[data-word="πλεκτος"]').click()
        check('new','Verbal adjective example button', 'πλεκτός', f.locator('#form').inner_text())
        f.locator('[data-word="οικτος"]').click()
        check('new','Non-verbal exception', 'οἶκτος', f.locator('#form').inner_text())
        explore('λογος')
        check('new','Unsupported input gets no prediction', 'Outside this selection|—', f.locator('#kind').inner_text()+'|'+f.locator('#form').inner_text())
        explore('')
        check('new','Empty input', 'Enter a Greek word|—', f.locator('#kind').inner_text()+'|'+f.locator('#form').inner_text())
        explore('Φαιστος');f.locator('#reset').click()
        check('new','Reset clears input and restores city sense', '|city|—', f.locator('#word').input_value()+'|'+f.locator('#sense').input_value()+'|'+f.locator('#form').inner_text())
        explore('πιστος')
        check('new','Narrow layout without horizontal overflow', True, fits(page,f,375))
        check('new','Desktop layout without horizontal overflow', True, fits(page,f,1100))
        check('new','No gadget script or console errors', '[]', json.dumps(errors))
        check('new','No attempted external requests', 0, len(requests))
        page.close()

        page, f, errors = load(bundle['past']['candidate'])
        def analyze(value):
            f.locator('#inp').fill(value);f.locator('#btn').click()
        check('past','Initial attested form', 'Κάρνος', f.locator('#suggest').inner_text())
        analyze('Λιβυρνος')
        check('past','First oxytone exception', 'Λιβυρνός', f.locator('#suggest').inner_text())
        analyze('Αχαρνος')
        check('past','Repaired second oxytone exception', 'Ἀχαρνός', f.locator('#suggest').inner_text())
        analyze('Σαμορνος')
        check('past','Repaired attested antepenult', 'Σάμορνος', f.locator('#suggest').inner_text())
        analyze('Αορνος')
        check('past','Repaired Aornos breathing and accent', 'Ἄορνος', f.locator('#suggest').inner_text())
        analyze('Φαλερνος')
        check('past','Italian group penult', 'Φαλέρνος', f.locator('#suggest').inner_text())
        analyze('Γονοι')
        check('past','Specific city spelling restoration', 'Γόννοι', f.locator('#nn').inner_text())
        analyze('πόνοι')
        check('past','No unsupported productive nu doubling', 'πόνοι', f.locator('#nn').inner_text())
        analyze('Ἄορνος');f.locator('#strip').uncheck()
        check('past','Preserve existing accent option without duplicate accents', 'Ἄορνος', f.locator('#suggest').inner_text())
        f.locator('[data-force="pen"]').click()
        check('past','Force replaces accent and preserves breathing', 'Ἀόρνος', f.locator('#forced').inner_text())
        f.locator('#mono').check()
        check('past','Monotonic option removes breathing', 'Άορνος', f.locator('#suggest').inner_text())
        analyze('αινος');f.locator('[data-force="ult"]').click()
        check('past','Forcing respects diphthong syllable count', 'αινός', f.locator('#forced').inner_text())
        analyze('Ζαρνος')
        check('past','Unknown rho-nos receives no attested claim', 'No attested form in this selection; no accent prediction is made.|Ζαρνος', f.locator('#noticed').inner_text()+'|'+f.locator('#suggest').inner_text())
        analyze('Καρνος Φαλερνος')
        check('past','Phrase outside supported scope', 'Enter one Greek word. Phrases and non-Greek input are outside this toy.', f.locator('#noticed').inner_text())
        analyze('')
        check('past','Empty input clears prior output', '—|—|—', '|'.join(f.locator(s).inner_text() for s in ['#suggest','#forced','#nn']))
        analyze('Καρνος');f.locator('#reset').click()
        check('past','Reset restores options and clears result', '|True|False|—', f.locator('#inp').input_value()+'|'+str(f.locator('#strip').is_checked())+'|'+str(f.locator('#mono').is_checked())+'|'+f.locator('#suggest').inner_text())
        analyze('Αχαρνος')
        check('past','Repaired narrow and desktop layouts without overflow', 'True|True', str(fits(page,f,375))+'|'+str(fits(page,f,1100)))
        check('past','No gadget script or console errors', '[]', json.dumps(errors))
        check('past','No attempted external requests', 0, len(requests))
        page.close()

        # Separate active confinement probes. These are never candidate source.
        probe = {
            'html': '<main id="probe">Confinement probes</main>', 'css': '',
            'js': '''window.blocked=[];
              document.addEventListener('securitypolicyviolation',e=>window.blocked.push(e.violatedDirective));
              const image=new Image();image.src='https://csp.invalid/resource';document.body.append(image);
              fetch('https://csp.invalid/connection').catch(()=>{});
              const form=document.createElement('form');form.action='https://csp.invalid/form';form.method='post';document.body.append(form);form.requestSubmit();'''
        }
        page, f, probe_errors = load(probe)
        f.wait_for_function("window.blocked.includes('img-src') && window.blocked.includes('connect-src') && window.blocked.includes('form-action')")
        directives=f.evaluate('Array.from(new Set(window.blocked)).sort().join(",")')
        confinement=directives+';requests='+str(len(requests))+';frame='+f.evaluate('document.URL')
        expected='connect-src,form-action,img-src;requests=0;frame=about:srcdoc'
        for role in ('new','past'):
            check(role,'Separate runtime CSP resource, connection and form probes',expected,confinement)
        page.close();context.close();browser.close()
    return {'browser':'Chromium '+version+' via Playwright; production gadget_srcdoc and sandbox allow-scripts allow-forms',
            'assertions': records, 'confinement': confinement,
            'candidate_sha256':{role:digest(bundle[role]['candidate']) for role in ('new','past')}}

if __name__ == '__main__':
    outcome=run(json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()))
    print(json.dumps(outcome,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))

Herodian’s -νος Accent Toy (ρ + -νος, -ερνος, and friends)

Type a Greek word (polytonic or monotonic). Explore attested forms in the passage: -νος with ρ before -νος tends to be barytone (accent not on the last syllable); Italian -ερνος tends to be paroxytone (accent on the penult). Known examples show their attested accent; unfamiliar words receive no accent prediction.

1) What the toy noticed

Patterns and qualifications
  • …ρνος (ρ immediately before -νος): barytone (not final accent)
  • …ερνος (Italian ethnics etc.): paroxytone (penult)
  • Λιβυρνός, Ἀχαρνός: named oxytone exceptions.
  • Unknown forms are left unchanged; you can still experiment below.

2) Accent playground

Suggested form
Your forced accent

Tip: try Καρνος vs Φαλερνος vs Λιβυρνος. The passage attests Κάρνος (barytone) and Φαλέρνος (penult).

3) Double-νν spotter (Γόννοι)

Herodian notes Γόννοι with νν (linked to Aeolic γόννα “knees”). Type Γονοι to restore this city’s attested Γόννοι. Other words are not respelled.

Spelling nudge
What this is (and isn’t)

This gadget is a tiny offline toy: it does not implement full Ancient Greek accentuation (quantity, recessive rules, enclitics, etc.). It shows selected attested forms and lets you experiment by forcing an acute on one of the last three syllables. The forcing tool groups common diphthongs, but does not enforce quantity or accent laws. Barytone means not accented on the final syllable; it need not mean a written grave.

            raise AssertionError(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False))
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.launch(executable_path=shutil.which('chromium'), headless=True, args=['--no-sandbox'])
        version = browser.version
        context = browser.new_context(viewport={'width': 1100, 'height': 1000})
        requests = []
        def abort(route):
            requests.append(route.request.resource_type)
            route.abort()
        context.route('**/*', abort)
        def load(candidate):
            page = context.new_page()
            errors = []
            page.on('pageerror', lambda e: errors.append('script error'))
            page.on('console', lambda msg: errors.append('console error') if msg.type == 'error' else None)
            src = gadget_srcdoc(**candidate)
            page.set_content('<!doctype html><html><head><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"></head><body style="margin:0"><iframe title="Educational gadget" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-forms" referrerpolicy="no-referrer" style="border:0;width:100%;height:1600px" srcdoc="'+escape(src, quote=True)+'"></iframe></body></html>')
            frame = page.frames[1]
            frame.locator('main, .wrap, #probe').first.wait_for()
            return page, frame, errors
        def fits(page, frame, width):
            page.set_viewport_size({'width': width, 'height': 1000})
            return frame.evaluate('document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth')

        page, f, errors = load(bundle['new']['candidate'])
        check('new','Initial passage example', 'πιστός', f.locator('#form').inner_text())
        def explore(value):
            f.locator('#word').fill(value)
            f.locator('#word').press('Enter')
        explore('πλειστος')
        check('new','Second input: superlative', 'πλεῖστος', f.locator('#form').inner_text())
        check('new','Superlative exception explained', True, 'superlative' in f.locator('#reason').inner_text() and f.locator('#kind').inner_text() == 'Barytone · superlative')
        explore('Φαιστος')
        check('new','City reading', 'Φαιστός', f.locator('#form').inner_text())
        f.locator('#sense').select_option('hero')
        check('new','Referent switch: hero', 'Φαῖστος', f.locator('#form').inner_text())
        check('new','Hero source citation', True, 'Iliad Ε 43' in f.locator('#reason').inner_text())
        explore('ἱστός'.lower())
        check('new','Accented breathing input', 'ἱστός', f.locator('#form').inner_text())
        explore('Δυστος')
        check('new','Named city exception', 'Δύστος', f.locator('#form').inner_text())
        f.locator('[data-word="πλεκτος"]').click()
        check('new','Verbal adjective example button', 'πλεκτός', f.locator('#form').inner_text())
        f.locator('[data-word="οικτος"]').click()
        check('new','Non-verbal exception', 'οἶκτος', f.locator('#form').inner_text())
        explore('λογος')
        check('new','Unsupported input gets no prediction', 'Outside this selection|—', f.locator('#kind').inner_text()+'|'+f.locator('#form').inner_text())
        explore('')
        check('new','Empty input', 'Enter a Greek word|—', f.locator('#kind').inner_text()+'|'+f.locator('#form').inner_text())
        explore('Φαιστος');f.locator('#reset').click()
        check('new','Reset clears input and restores city sense', '|city|—', f.locator('#word').input_value()+'|'+f.locator('#sense').input_value()+'|'+f.locator('#form').inner_text())
        explore('πιστος')
        check('new','Narrow layout without horizontal overflow', True, fits(page,f,375))
        check('new','Desktop layout without horizontal overflow', True, fits(page,f,1100))
        check('new','No gadget script or console errors', '[]', json.dumps(errors))
        check('new','No attempted external requests', 0, len(requests))
        page.close()

        page, f, errors = load(bundle['past']['candidate'])
        def analyze(value):
            f.locator('#inp').fill(value);f.locator('#btn').click()
        check('past','Initial attested form', 'Κάρνος', f.locator('#suggest').inner_text())
        analyze('Λιβυρνος')
        check('past','First oxytone exception', 'Λιβυρνός', f.locator('#suggest').inner_text())
        analyze('Αχαρνος')
        check('past','Repaired second oxytone exception', 'Ἀχαρνός', f.locator('#suggest').inner_text())
        analyze('Σαμορνος')
        check('past','Repaired attested antepenult', 'Σάμορνος', f.locator('#suggest').inner_text())
        analyze('Αορνος')
        check('past','Repaired Aornos breathing and accent', 'Ἄορνος', f.locator('#suggest').inner_text())
        analyze('Φαλερνος')
        check('past','Italian group penult', 'Φαλέρνος', f.locator('#suggest').inner_text())
        analyze('Γονοι')
        check('past','Specific city spelling restoration', 'Γόννοι', f.locator('#nn').inner_text())
        analyze('πόνοι')
        check('past','No unsupported productive nu doubling', 'πόνοι', f.locator('#nn').inner_text())
        analyze('Ἄορνος');f.locator('#strip').uncheck()
        check('past','Preserve existing accent option without duplicate accents', 'Ἄορνος', f.locator('#suggest').inner_text())
        f.locator('[data-force="pen"]').click()
        check('past','Force replaces accent and preserves breathing', 'Ἀόρνος', f.locator('#forced').inner_text())
        f.locator('#mono').check()
        check('past','Monotonic option removes breathing', 'Άορνος', f.locator('#suggest').inner_text())
        analyze('αινος');f.locator('[data-force="ult"]').click()
        check('past','Forcing respects diphthong syllable count', 'αινός', f.locator('#forced').inner_text())
        analyze('Ζαρνος')
        check('past','Unknown rho-nos receives no attested claim', 'No attested form in this selection; no accent prediction is made.|Ζαρνος', f.locator('#noticed').inner_text()+'|'+f.locator('#suggest').inner_text())
        analyze('Καρνος Φαλερνος')
        check('past','Phrase outside supported scope', 'Enter one Greek word. Phrases and non-Greek input are outside this toy.', f.locator('#noticed').inner_text())
        analyze('')
        check('past','Empty input clears prior output', '—|—|—', '|'.join(f.locator(s).inner_text() for s in ['#suggest','#forced','#nn']))
        analyze('Καρνος');f.locator('#reset').click()
        check('past','Reset restores options and clears result', '|True|False|—', f.locator('#inp').input_value()+'|'+str(f.locator('#strip').is_checked())+'|'+str(f.locator('#mono').is_checked())+'|'+f.locator('#suggest').inner_text())
        analyze('Αχαρνος')
        check('past','Repaired narrow and desktop layouts without overflow', 'True|True', str(fits(page,f,375))+'|'+str(fits(page,f,1100)))
        check('past','No gadget script or console errors', '[]', json.dumps(errors))
        check('past','No attempted external requests', 0, len(requests))
        page.close()

        # Separate active confinement probes. These are never candidate source.
        probe = {
            'html': '<main id="probe">Confinement probes</main>', 'css': '',
            'js': '''window.blocked=[];
              document.addEventListener('securitypolicyviolation',e=>window.blocked.push(e.violatedDirective));
              const image=new Image();image.src='https://csp.invalid/resource';document.body.append(image);
              fetch('https://csp.invalid/connection').catch(()=>{});
              const form=document.createElement('form');form.action='https://csp.invalid/form';form.method='post';document.body.append(form);form.requestSubmit();'''
        }
        page, f, probe_errors = load(probe)
        f.wait_for_function("window.blocked.includes('img-src') && window.blocked.includes('connect-src') && window.blocked.includes('form-action')")
        directives=f.evaluate('Array.from(new Set(window.blocked)).sort().join(",")')
        confinement=directives+';requests='+str(len(requests))+';frame='+f.evaluate('document.URL')
        expected='connect-src,form-action,img-src;requests=0;frame=about:srcdoc'
        for role in ('new','past'):
            check(role,'Separate runtime CSP resource, connection and form probes',expected,confinement)
        page.close();context.close();browser.close()
    return {'browser':'Chromium '+version+' via Playwright; production gadget_srcdoc and sandbox allow-scripts allow-forms',
            'assertions': records, 'confinement': confinement,
            'candidate_sha256':{role:digest(bundle[role]['candidate']) for role in ('new','past')}}
